name: Wei Zhang
headline: Machine Learning Engineer (Computer Vision)
summary: ML engineer focused on computer vision for robotics and logistics, from data collection and labelling to models running on edge devices.

experience.title: Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: Train and ship PyTorch computer vision models for warehouse robots, lifting pick accuracy from 91% to 97.5%.
Exported models to ONNX and cut on-device inference time from 80 ms to 23 ms on edge GPUs.
Built the FastAPI model-serving gateway, with Docker images rolled out to 400 robots through staged updates.
Set up a Python evaluation harness that replays 2 million labelled frames before every release.

experience.title: Computer Vision Engineer
bullets: Developed PyTorch computer vision models that count shipping containers from port cameras, replacing manual tallies at three terminals.
Wrote NumPy pre-processing for 4K video streams, doubling throughput per GPU.
Stored detections and audit trails in MongoDB for the customer-facing reporting tool.
Curated a 120,000-image dataset with a two-person annotation team.

education.institution: Jiangnan University of Science and Technology

projects.name: open-pallet
projects.description: Open-source PyTorch dataset loaders and baselines for pallet and parcel detection.
